_source: Natural Earth 1:50m Cultural Vectors, Admin 0 -- Countries (https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/50m-cultural-vectors/50m-admin-0-countries/), fetched as GeoJSON from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_50m_admin_0_countries.geojson -- the SAME file ne_50m_car.json was cut from, and it carries all three of these territories. build-basemap.mjs's header asserted for one milestone that Natural Earth had no polygon for them at any cheaply reachable resolution; that was false, and this file is the disproof: Guam (12 points, single polygon), N. Mariana Is. (46 points across 6 rings -- Rota, Aguijan, Tinian, Saipan and three northern islands) and American Samoa (8 points, Tutuila) are all distinct features here. Public domain (https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/ -- 'No permission is needed to use Natural Earth. Crediting the authors is unnecessary.'). Filtered here (one-time, offline) to SOVEREIGNT == 'United States of America' AND NAME in ('Guam', 'N. Mariana Is.', 'American Samoa') -- Admin-0 COUNTRIES, not Admin-1 states/provinces, for the same reason ne_50m_car.json is (these are not Admin-1 units of any country in Natural Earth), so this file's schema (properties.name/postal, geometry Polygon/MultiPolygon) matches ne_110m_us.json's by convention rather than by shared source layer. `name` is the source's NAME_LONG, not its NAME -- the two differ for exactly the features whose NAME is abbreviated ('N. Mariana Is.' -> 'Northern Mariana Islands'), and ne_50m_car.json's committed 'United States Virgin Islands' (source NAME 'U.S. Virgin Is.') is what pins that convention. MIDWAY IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT, and the reason is scope rather than absence. This 1:50m file genuinely has no Midway; the 1:10m one does, but only inside a 13-ring 'U.S. Minor Outlying Is.' feature whose other rings include Navassa Island in the CARIBBEAN (-75.0, 18.4), and build-basemap.mjs classifies a whole feature by regionOf(rings[0][0]) -- so taking that feature whole projects Navassa into the Pacific. A RING-LEVEL filter would extract Midway, and this file is already a hand-filtered artifact, so that is the same class of operation. What rules it out is that ring indices are not stable across a Natural Earth refresh: an input meaning 'ring 4 of this feature' silently becomes a different island when upstream reorders. The gap is stated on the page instead -- NetworkMap.tsx's `nwhi`-empty caption. Properties trimmed to name/postal, coordinates rounded to 4 decimals (~11m), matching ne_50m_car.json's precision and this file's shared 1:50m source. Features sorted by postal, as the generator re-sorts them anyway. Fetched 2026-08-25. This is the raw input to app/scripts/build-basemap.mjs -- do not hand-edit; re-run the fetch + filter step (recorded in build-basemap.mjs's header) and regenerate if it ever needs to change.
